item.title: Bulletin updated at 07:50 HKT 09/May/2025
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
A trough of low pressure will bring showers and thunderstorms to the coast of southern China today and tomorrow. Under the influence of the associated northeast monsoon, the weather over southern China will improve and temperatures will fall slightly early next week. A southerly airstream will affect the coast of Guangdong in the middle and latter parts of next week. There will be a few showers over the region, and it will be hot during the day.

Date/Month: 09/05 (Friday)
Wind: Light winds force 2 at first, northeast force 3 at night.
Weather: Mainly cloudy with a few showers. Showers will be heavier in some areas later with a few squally thunderstorms. Coastal fog at first.
Temp range: 26 - 31 C
R.H. range: 65 - 95 per Cent
PSR: Medium High
